flora: Leathery pinna (individual leaflet with rounded, thick edges)
Protective scales (fuzzy, bronze-colored base of the plant)
Cured frond (dried, brown, curled-up dormant leaf)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; thick, durable leaf textures; focus on the 'fuzzy' protective base; avoid thin or wispy elements; emphasize the resilience required for semi-arid life.

visual_logic.composition: Tiled layout: Top-Left: a close-up of a vibrant but leathery green leaflet; Top-Right: a beautiful leaf impression in a slab of red Plottier stone; Bottom-Left: the fuzzy, scaled base of the fern crown; Bottom-Right: a dormant, curled-up brown frond.
visual_logic.ground: Pinkish-grey sandy soil with ripples, typical of wind-blown plains.
visual_logic.lighting: Even, bright light to clearly distinguish the bronze 'fur' from the green leaf tissue and red rock.
